description: Representative bcrypt load from the release manual: cost=10 hashing and comparison, executed single threaded in fresh Node.js processes. Cost=12 scenarios extend the same load to a four-times more expensive work factor.

selection.reason: node.bcrypt.js ships no benchmark suite; the release manual defines a fixed cost=10 hash/compare load with ten synchronous operations. This case keeps that load, adds the asynchronous API (same C++ work on the libuv thread pool) and a cost=12 hashing scenario to cover a harder work factor.
excluded: concurrent/parallel hashing, because the manual measures single-threaded throughput and the libuv thread pool size would otherwise become an untracked variable
